01Customer & Employee ChatbotsPersonal information · Policy coverage · Internal knowledge3 service domains↗

One product portfolio spanning customer information, policy coverage and organizational knowledge.

The problem

Customers and service teams need policy-specific answers, but information lives across policies, knowledge bases and customer systems. Ambiguous questions and long answers create friction.

My role

I own discovery, roadmap and requirements across the chatbot portfolio. I connect service, legal, CRM and AI teams around context, permissions, follow-up questions and escalation.

Separate information sources. Repeated searches. Unclear questions passed to people without enough context.

How it works

Select an icon for details

Capture the question and clarify the customer’s intent before retrieving information.

Evidence & evaluation

3,238 analyzed queries · 1,130 short or ambiguous queries (~35%). This baseline informed conversational priorities. The policy coverage assistant received national recognition from People & Computers.

Measure task completion, answer quality, human escalation, latency and cost per resolved inquiry.

Delivery status

Coverage assistant: iteration and audience expansion. Knowledge assistant: pilot and feedback. Customer-information integration: discovery and source readiness. The diagram shows the proposed workflow across these three assistants.

02Medical Document Analysis for UnderwritingMedical profiles · Missing documents · Source references95% coverage criterion↗

Turning fragmented medical information into a traceable underwriting profile.

The problem

Underwriters read questionnaires and medical records, reconcile diagnoses and chase missing evidence before a file is ready for assessment.

My role

I led discovery, PRDs and acceptance criteria for medical profiles, diagnosis-linked document gaps and review flows. I align underwriting experts, AI and data teams on the quality required before scaling.

Manual reading across documents. Repeated checks against declarations. Gaps discovered late in the process.

How it works

Select an icon for details

Bring medical records and health questionnaires into a defined document-processing flow.

Evidence & evaluation

POC criteria: ≥95% relevant diagnosis coverage · 100% source linking · zero invented diagnoses. Processing-time target: about 4 minutes for a roughly 78-page profile. These are evaluation thresholds, not achieved results.

Evaluate diagnosis coverage, numeric accuracy, missing-document detection, traceability and review effort.

Delivery status

Documented work covers product definition and POC evaluation. Production rollout and realized labor savings are not yet established. Underwriters retain the review and decision role.

03Bodily Injury Claims AnalysisMedical records · Court judgments · Expert opinions3 evidence types↗

Connecting medical records, judgments and expert opinions in one review experience.

The problem

Claims teams need to reconstruct a coherent case from medical and legal documents before assessing liability, disability and risk.

My role

I led discovery and product specification, created claimant-profile and summary flows, and built an interactive prototype. I defined the next-stage direction for recommendations informed by historical cases.

Medical and legal evidence reviewed separately. Case context rebuilt manually. Historical knowledge difficult to reuse.

How it works

Select an icon for details

Organize medical records, legal judgments and expert opinions around the claim.

Evidence & evaluation

3 source types: medical records, judgments and prior expert opinions. Delivered: PRD, user stories, prompts, example cases and an interactive HTML prototype.

Evaluate summary completeness, source attribution, reviewer effort and recommendation quality before any model-based rollout.

Delivery status

Product definition and interactive prototype. Historical-case ML recommendations are a proposed next stage; a trained or deployed model, model name and validated performance have not been confirmed.
